newsitem.title: UK: Clyde rejects Gulf Canada offer.
newsitem.headline: Clyde rejects Gulf Canada offer.

text.p: Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc said on Wednesday that an offer from Gulf Canada Resources Ltd was "unsolicited and wholly unacceptable".

Clyde said in a statement that it strongly advised shareholders to take no action whatsoever and to ignore any documents they may receive from the Canadian-based oil and natural gas exploration and production company.
The company said the reasons for its rejection will be set out in a letter to shareholders in due course.
Gulf Canada earlier launched a cash offer of 105 pence per share for Clyde, valuing the oil and gas exploration company at 432 million stg.
